SELECT BOARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO board (bnum, btitle, bcontent, bwriter) VALUES (#{bnum}, #{btitle}, #{bcontent}, #{bwriter})
mapper.select: select bnum, btitle, bcontent, bwriter, bdate from (select bnum, btitle, bcontent, bwriter, bdate, row_number() over(order by bnum desc) as rNum from board ) MP where rNum between #{rowStart} and #{rowEnd} order by bnum desc
SELECT COUNT(bnum) FROM BOARD WHERE bnum > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mp_FILE ( FILENUM, BNUM, ORGFILENAME, STOREDFILENAME, MPFILESIZE ) VALUES ( FILENUM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{BNUM}, #{ORGFILENAME}, #{STOREDFILENAME}, #{MPFILESIZE} )
mapper.select:
select FILENUM, ORGFILENAME,
ROUND(MPFILESIZE/1024, 1) as MPFILESIZE, DELGB from MP_FILE where BNUM = #{BNUM} and DELGB = 'N'
ORDER BY FILENUM ASC
SELECT STOREDFILENAME, ORGFILENAME FROM MP_FILE where FILENUM = #{FILENUM}
